name: The Hand of Rastakhan
label: Quest
description: The Hand of Rastakhan: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, our worst fears have come. Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute. If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of Azeroth!

There is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness. They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda. Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You were sent by the prospector, Ironboot? His kind are wise, and wiser still to bring you to me, for I and the Zandalarian trolls may know a way to defeat the Soulflayer.
Speak with the trolls of this isle, heed their words, and prepare yourself, friend, for the task before you is soaked in blood.
